@graph.description: Canban is an open-source lightweight native macOS and Linux desktop workbench built in Rust that unifies flexible Kanban cards, a global Notification Center, GitHub Actions-like Workflows with isolated Git worktrees and FIFO Queue Merge, built-in Git diff review, and Herdr persistent PTY terminals for 24 native AI coding agent CLIs.
featureList: Flexible Kanban board with Markdown specs, #Card links, screenshots, @Agent discussions, per-card Git worktrees, and GitHub Issue/PR sync
GitHub Actions-like YAML workflows & Visual Studio with shell scripts, agent + prompt steps, cron schedules, and serialized FIFO Queue Merge
Global Notification Center (⌘I) across all projects, terminals, and remote hosts with one-click jump to Card and live TTY
Native Agent CLI support in persistent Herdr PTY terminals (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor CLI, Pi, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and 20+ CLIs) powered by Rust, longbridge/nsh, and libghostty-vt
Built-in Git diff review with inline comments and simultaneous multi-host Linux canband connections over SSH or Tailscale
